craft_notes: Sthāyin: scaffold-joy. Close: number. Rejected: 'elements' — killed: lords kept; 'pentad' — killed: five plain.

lines: Fourfold the holds of wind-fire-water lords; above,
the famed śa-row, and before them, brahma-five.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vāyvagnisalilendrāṇāṃ dhāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam | tadūrdhve śādivikhyātam purastād brahmapañcakam
